analytic_scene.reference_scope: Independent FP64 direct GGX/Smith/Schlick integral over analytically clipped rectangle; Lambert closed form validates geometry and energy only. RGB8 inverse-sRGB quantization is reported separately.

acceptance_8.denominator: peak of unoccluded independent linear reference for the same fixed center-row ROI
acceptance_8.zero_baseline_error_policy: relative improvement unavailable; never divide by epsilon or claim improvement
acceptance_8.scope: Both traversal paths and every preregistered phase must be reported; failure retains counterexample. No threshold retuning.

panda.scope: Same archived poses, mesh/material/camera hashes; ID-derived ROIs are fixed by source membership, not selected after seeing errors. Changes/banding only, no Panda ground-truth claim.

cost.scope: Per traversal and grid; actual capture wall time and optional GPU timestamps, with hardware TLAS build/update included. No resolution reduction or postfilter.
